what: The plan’s linter ties the ⚠ banner to “within 20 lines above the fence” (and the sibling doc draft says “±20 lines above fence”) while the issue requires BOTH markers “within ±20 lines of the invocation.”
scenario_or_breakage: A long ```bash fence can place the invocation many lines below the fence start; a banner just above the fence can satisfy the plan yet violate the written acceptance distance to the invocation line; sibling spec also disagrees with the algorithm bullet on ± vs above-only.
suggested_fix: Amend the plan: either align the linter with acceptance (measure from the matched invocation line for both banner and fence-local comment, with ±20 as in the issue) or explicitly record an operator-approved relaxation of acceptance #3 and make `scripts/lint-foreground-markers.md` match the implemented algorithm verbatim.

what: The plan states that wiring `lint-foreground` into `make lint` lets “pre-commit / CI” pick it up “without additional workflow plumbing,” but CI’s `lint` job runs `make lint-only` (pre-commit hooks only), not `make lint`.
scenario_or_breakage: New `scripts/lint-foreground-markers.sh` would not run on PR CI unless added as a pre-commit local hook, invoked from an existing CI step, or covered indirectly; acceptance “Fails CI on drift” is not met by Makefile-only wiring.
suggested_fix: Add an explicit implementation step: register a `local` pre-commit hook for `lint-foreground-markers.sh` and/or extend `.github/workflows/ci.yaml`, and/or append `test-lint-foreground-markers` to a `test-harnesses-*` shard; delete or rewrite plan.txt:56-57’s CI claim to match the chosen path.

what: The plan adds `test-lint-foreground-markers` but does not require appending it to any `test-harnesses-N` shard line (the pattern used for `test-lint-bash32` at Makefile:72).
scenario_or_breakage: `make test-lint-foreground-markers` would only run when invoked explicitly; default CI harness matrix would skip it unless registered like other harnesses.
suggested_fix: Append `test-lint-foreground-markers` to one `test-harnesses-*` line (and extend the `.PHONY` / shard-coverage contract per `docs/linting.md` if applicable).

what: The testing section says the harness participates in “CI’s normal lint chain” via `lint-bash32`; in this repo `lint-bash32` is not the CI `lint` job step—it is exercised via harness targets such as `test-lint-bash32` in the harness matrix (see Makefile:72).
scenario_or_breakage: Implementers may misunderstand which CI surface actually executes shell portability checks and mirror the wrong wiring for the new linter.
suggested_fix: Rephrase to: run `test-lint-foreground-markers` from a harness shard and/or match `scripts/lint-bash32.md`’s documented callers (`scripts/lint-bash32.md:7` pattern).

what: The executable contract splits banner proximity (outside fence, near fence top) from comment proximity (±5 inside fence) but never pins the binding-decision banner as a literal required leading line for the linter (issue body gives the exact markdown).
scenario_or_breakage: Linter false negatives if authors keep legacy `⚠` prose whose first line is not byte-identical to the binding decision, or false positives if the canonical phrase is underspecified.
suggested_fix: Copy the exact banner line from the issue’s “Binding decisions” into the plan and require the linter to match that literal (or a documented normalization) and update `scripts/lint-foreground-markers.md` accordingly.

what: The “Files to modify” inventory lists design/implement/shared/review surfaces but omits research reference files that already fence-invoke `collect-agent-results.sh` (a denylisted basename).
scenario_or_breakage: Implementers relying on the enumerated list alone may skip `/research` paths until step 3; not fatal if step 3 is rigorous, but it weakens traceability to the issue’s “repo-wide … including /research” audit scope.
suggested_fix: Extend the explicit inventory to include `skills/research/references/research-phase.md` and `skills/research/references/validation-phase.md` (and any other hits from the step-3 audit), or state that step 3’s `make lint-foreground` output is the authoritative checklist for all `skills/**` paths.

what: The plan mitigates accidental prose reflow after marker insertion (`test-implement-structure.sh` timing regex, etc.) but the testing strategy does not spell a Family A spot-check despite “MUST NOT regress Family A invocations.”
scenario_or_breakage: Parallel-launch blocks could be unintentionally edited while batch-editing nearby markdown; denylist-only lint does not detect removal of `run_in_background: true` from Family A sites.
suggested_fix: Add an explicit validation step: grep or manual checklist for known Family A launch fences (`launch-review.sh`, `launch-codex-implement.sh`, `launch-cursor-implement.sh`) ensuring `run_in_background: true` and collector pairing remain unchanged.
